note: What M1-14 -- the HDR target and the resolve pass -- costs per frame, and what each alternative the owner weighed on 2026-09-24 would have saved. docs/measurements/m1-14-frame-cost.md describes every variant and comparison. The edits add Vulkan timestamp queries and two environment switches to the named commits, in a disposable worktree; none of it is ever committed to the application.

edits.why: own the query pool, so it is destroyed before the device
edits.replace:
UniqueAllocator allocator_;
    OwnedHandle<VkQueryPool, VkDevice, vkDestroyQueryPool> measurePool_; // MEASUREMENT ONLY

edits.why: silence the warnings the measurement code would raise
edits.replace:
#pragma clang diagnostic ignored "-Weverything" // MEASUREMENT ONLY: never committed
#include "render/VulkanContext.hpp"

edits.why: create the query pool and print the device
read the slot's timestamps once its fence has signalled
timestamp at the start of the frame
timestamp at the end of the frame
edits.replace:
vkCmdWriteTimestamp2(frame.cmd, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_ALL_COMMANDS_BIT, gMeasurePool, frame.frameIndex * 2 + 1);
    if (auto ok = vkCheck(vkEndCommandBuffer(frame.cmd), "vkEndCommandBuffer"); !ok) return ok;

edits.why: own the query pool, so it is destroyed before the device
edits.replace:
UniqueAllocator allocator_;
    OwnedHandle<VkQueryPool, VkDevice, vkDestroyQueryPool> measurePool_; // MEASUREMENT ONLY
